name: Anthropic Chat
description: Chat with Anthropic Claude models using the native Anthropic API. The API key is your own stored ANTHROPIC_API_KEY by default; pass apiKey as 's/<SECRET_NAME>' for another of your secrets, '<did>/s/<SECRET_NAME>' for one granted to you with secret/use, or a literal. Supports system prompts, tools, and structured output. Prompt caching is on by default: tools, system prompt and the caller's cacheMarks are cache breakpoints; usage reports cacheRead and cacheWrite tokens.
creator: Covia

messages.description: Chat messages (advanced mode). A user message's content may be a string, or an array of content blocks for vision. PREFERRED for images: reference stored content — {type:'image', source:{type:'asset', ref:'a/<hash> | w/<path> | dlfs/<drive>/<path> | did:...'}} — resolved at call time under your authority, so the job record keeps a tiny reference instead of megabytes of image data (store once via asset_store, content-address deduped). Inline also supported for small images: {type:'image', source:{type:'base64', mediaType:'image/jpeg', data:'...'}}. Text blocks: {type:'text', text:'...'}

model.description: Model name. Sonnet 5.5 is the balanced default; Opus 5.5 targets complex agentic work, Fable 5.1 the longest and hardest work, and Haiku 5.5 economical or latency-sensitive work.

apiKey.description: Anthropic API key (resolved from the secret store, then process environment, by default — see operation.secretKey)

temperature.description: Sampling temperature; provider default when omitted. Current Claude models (Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, Haiku 5.5, Fable 5.1) reject non-default values: leave unset and use providerOptions output_config.effort instead.

topP.description: Nucleus sampling top_p; provider default when omitted. Rejected by current Claude models, as for temperature.

providerOptions.description: Provider-native request body fields forwarded unchanged; omitted fields retain Anthropic defaults. Do not repeat the shared model/messages/tools/max_tokens/temperature/top_p envelope here. Example for current Claude models: {output_config:{effort:'low'}} (thinking is always on for Opus 5.5 and Fable 5.1; do not send thinking:{type:'disabled'})

modelOptions.description: Per-call overrides of model.options in the effective model definition. Agents forward config.modelOptions. Implemented with LangChain4j, including its message mapping and transport.

nativeSystemMessages.description: Send late instructions in-position as native system messages after the user/tool-result turn; false uses the portable text fallback.

automaticCaching.description: Use the provider's moving conversation cache breakpoint instead of Covia's explicit conversation cacheMarks. System/tool caching remains enabled. Ignored when cache:false.

thinkingPrefixMismatch.description: Leave provider enforcement unchanged, explicitly reject edited thinking prefixes, or drop invalid thinking and report inputTransformations (beta).

cacheTtl.description: Duration of every enabled cache breakpoint. Defaults to 5m; cache:false disables all caching.

preserveThinking.description: Reserved for lossless cross-turn thinking preservation; disabled pending upstream support. Required single-block tool-turn state is already retained.

inlineToolChanges.description: Reserved; disabled pending LangChain4j support for native tool-addition/removal blocks.

compaction.description: Reserved; disabled pending LangChain4j support for signed and threshold compaction blocks.

maxTokens.description: Maximum output tokens for the response (bounds cost/latency; e.g. 1024 for extraction calls). Defaults to 8192 from operation metadata; model metadata and caller input may override it.

cache.description: Prompt caching (default true): the tool definitions and the system prompt are marked as cache breakpoints and cacheMarks are honoured. Set false to disable caching for this call.

cacheMarks.description: Indices of conversation cache breakpoints. Duration comes from modelOptions.cacheTtl (default 5m). Ignored when automaticCaching is enabled, which uses the provider's moving breakpoint instead.

providerState.description: Opaque provider continuation state on a tool-use reply. Preserve it unchanged with that assistant message; Covia restores it only for the same provider and model.

finishReason.description: Provider finish reason in lower case (for example stop, length, or tool_execution). A length response reached maxTokens and is incomplete.

inputTransformations.description: Provider-reported input transformations, including thinking dropped after a prefix edit.
